description: The main window, by the label MAIN_WINDOW in src/lib.rs; rename both together. Grants the nine bridge commands of src/commands.rs, one permission each (docs/decisions/0012-desktop-bridge.md), and the six window commands the room's title bar needs, WINDOW_PERMISSIONS in src/window_frame.rs (docs/decisions/0015-window-frame.md): drag, double-click, minimise, maximise or restore, close, and whether it is maximised. Nothing else: every permission widens what script in the page can reach.
